CustomField.description: Self-lookup to the Contact who referred this investor Contact. Receives its value from Lead.Referred_By__c on conversion via InvestorLeadConvertService — no user action is required to populate it directly. Distinct relationshipName from Lead.Referred_By__c (both point at Contact and would otherwise collide on the child relationship name).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Contact who referred this investor, if known.
CustomField.label: Referred By
